findings.title: Paged/search subgroup methods still dereference a possibly-null model supplier
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() was changed to handle modelSupplier.get() returning null when a group has been deleted concurrently, but getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) at line 268 still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. Under the same concurrent-delete scenario the supplier can return null, so these methods can throw the same NullPointerException the PR is trying to fix.

findings.title: Concurrency test can pass without exercising the race and may miss exceptions
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread, deletes groups, sets deletedAll, and immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty. It never ensures that the reader thread actually performed requests, and it does not join or otherwise await termination before asserting. If the thread is not scheduled before deletions complete, the loop may never run; if it is still running when the assertion executes, later exceptions are missed; and the thread can continue after the test. Use a latch/count to guarantee reads occur during deletion, await the reader thread, then assert.
